coverage.gate_event_and_fsync_timing: not retained in F4 raw events
coverage.t07_power_loss: not tested; real process death only
coverage.t18_exact: accepted-order correspondence with client-send event unlogged
coverage.t18_use_current_fixture: prepared-only; recorded schedule is narrower analogy

detached_mutant.reason: detached old authority check accepted stale request after replacement

exact_obligation.reason: matching exact committed obligation delivered after replacement
exact_obligation.unresolved: client-send event not separately logged; profile-specific analogy, not use-current authorization

accepted_before_ack.limitation: no retry recorded; F2 power-loss case not reproduced
accepted_before_ack.reason: no reply; independent reader recovered one exact effect

early_ack_mutant.limitation: empty and missing journal are indistinguishable in recorded runner
early_ack_mutant.reason: success ACK without a recoverable matching effect

preaccept.limitation: empty and missing journal indistinguishable; gate event not retained
preaccept.reason: no reply and reader reports zero effects; not a denial

uninterrupted.limitation: gate events and fsync timing are not retained in raw output; process death only
uninterrupted.reason: success reply and one exact recovered effect

ordered.reason: held old request rejected after replacement; current requests accepted
ordered.unresolved: request was initiated before replacement, while F2 sink_send follows revoke; replacement is not automatically equivalent to that revoke

recorded_truncated_control.reason: fresh reader refused truncated journal; no empty successful recovery
